exposure: timing of VP16 initiation relative to symptom onset
cohort: 41 pregnant patients diagnosed with hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH), either during pregnancy or postpartum, admitted to a hospital between April 2015 and March 2024.
finding: Early administration of VP16-containing chemotherapy significantly improved the overall response rate and survival outcomes in pregnant patients with HLH, especially in pregnancy-related HLH.
